title: Shared Practice Frame and Surface Inventory

surfacesFound.owner: B1 shared renderer and Case Trainer
B1 shared renderer and Case Trainer

surfaceDivergences.divergence: Article/case table is owned by the legacy Case Trainer renderer renderMiniTable(mode), not by the B1 display adapter layer.
surfaceDivergences.risk: Future feedback changes can miss article-grid feedback or flatten it into generic correction text.
surfaceDivergences.allowed: Protected component; keep as distinct adapter in the shared-frame contract.

surfaceDivergences.divergence: Both use #answerInput, but B1 uses b1Runtime/checkB1Answer/renderB1Feedback while Case Trainer uses current/checkAnswer/renderMiniTable.
surfaceDivergences.risk: Same typed input can receive different feedback hierarchy and HUD/result behaviour.

surfaceDivergences.divergence: B1 result flow uses b1Runtime summaries and Learning Map routing; Case Trainer result flow uses score/rank/heatmap and New Practice routing.
surfaceDivergences.risk: Feedback rhythm or article-grid result changes need explicit adapter rules.

sameSurfaceDifferentLayouts.comparison: Today/diagnostic/connectors all use the B1 shared choice grid when rendered as B1 items.
sameSurfaceDifferentLayouts.status: Mostly unified; route label/title and item pool differ.

sameSurfaceDifferentLayouts.comparison: B1 cloze from Today, Wortschatz, Redemittel, and QA fixtures uses the B1 visual template and #b1InlineInput when item metadata resolves to inline cloze.
sameSurfaceDifferentLayouts.status: Mostly unified; deterministic route comparison uses QA fixtures because route queues are adaptive.

sameSurfaceDifferentLayouts.comparison: B1 repair/transformation typed input and Case Trainer typed article input both use #answerInput but separate render/check/feedback ownership.
sameSurfaceDifferentLayouts.status: Divergent; needs convergence adapter before feedback rhythm work.

sameSurfaceDifferentLayouts.comparison: Only Case Trainer currently owns the article grid; B1 cases/articles repair items do not expose the grid as a protected adapter.
sameSurfaceDifferentLayouts.status: Divergent; article-grid integration should be explicit.

staticInventory.b1Frame: B1 routes render through renderB1Question(), renderB1Feedback(), renderConnectorChoices(), renderProductionControls(), and shared #answerArea / #supportColumn slots.
staticInventory.caseTrainerFrame: Case Trainer renders through renderQuestion(), checkAnswer(), renderMiniTable(), showResults(), and renderHud() using the same visible DOM IDs but separate legacy state/current variables.
